topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I climbed up to the attic, flashlight in hand, ready to check for any leaks before the winter storm hits. The space was dusty, with old floorboards creaking under my weight. But what caught my eye wasn't a leak or a hole. Piled neatly in the corner were boxes and bundles, wrapped in what looked like old sheets. I peeled back a corner of one, revealing a vintage typewriter and a stack of yellowed letters. More digging uncovered a collection of old photographs and a leather-bound journal. This attic held stories I never knew were hiding, layers of life from the previous owners, now mine to uncover.
